name: Artisan Slider
author: Arth Patel

sections.description:
Artisan Slider is a simple yet powerful circular thumbnail slider built for Elementor.
It features smooth transitions, autoplay options, and custom styling to match your site perfectly.

Features:

  • Circular thumbnail navigation
  • Fully responsive and lightweight
  • Easy to customize via Elementor settings
  • Autoplay and manual navigation support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/artisan-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the new Artisan Slider widget inside Elementor to create beautiful sliders.
sections.faq:
Does it work only with Elementor?

Yes, this plugin requires Elementor to work.

Can I control the number of thumbnails?

Yes, you can adjust thumbnails and settings easily from the widget controls.
